them.zh: 托管服务与 CLI 做的

steps.en: Get one API key on the vendor site, install the CLI, hand it the key
steps.zh: 在官网建一把 API Key，装好 CLI 并把 Key 交给它

steps.en: Ask for one security's data by name or code
steps.zh: 用名称或代码发起一次取数

steps.en: Resolves the name to the unique thscode and routes to the right REST/MCP endpoint
steps.zh: 把名称消歧成唯一 thscode，路由到对应的 REST/MCP 接口

steps.en: Returns one normalized envelope that preserves nulls; oversized results go to disk
steps.zh: 返回统一信封并保留空值，超大结果落盘

steps.en: When you need long history, initialise the local database
steps.zh: 需要长历史时，初始化本地库

steps.en: Downloads the full-market Parquet dump, then applies incremental updates
steps.zh: 下载全市场 Parquet 全量包，再按增量写入

steps.en: Run SQL against the local copy instead of refetching
steps.zh: 直接对本地副本跑 SQL，不必再远端取数
steps.code: hithink-finance db query --sql "SELECT * FROM v_daily_qfq LIMIT 10"

value.en: You stop maintaining scrapers and field maps: one key buys contractual A-share fields over four surfaces, and history becomes a local table you can SQL
value.zh: 不用再自己维护爬虫和字段映射：一把 Key 在四个入口上拿到有契约的 A 股字段，长历史落成本地表可直接 SQL 查
